senses.gloss: m. (v. כָּלַב; cmp. פֶּה, στόμα for edge) a sharp instrument, axe.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 13:20">Targ. I Sam. XIII, 20</cite> (some ed. <he>כלוב׳</he>, Ar. <cite ref="K00275"><he>כולכא</he></cite>; h. text <cite ref="S01915"><he>קרדם</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> <he>אייטו לי כולב</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אייתי לי קולב</he>), v. <cite ref="J00316"><he>יְטִי</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 4:1">Lev. R. s. 4</cite> <he>הן די … זיינא כּוּלְבֵיה וכ׳</he> (not <he>זייניה כולבא</he>) where the owner of arms (warrior) hangs up his battle axe, the shepherd hangs up his bag, i.e. in the place of justice sits wickedness; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:16">Koh. R. to III, 16</cite> <he>קולביה</he>; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 969">Yalk. Koh. 969</cite> <he>באתרא … זייניה</he> where the lord hangs up his armor).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 1:2:2">Y. Naz. I, 51ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="K00263"><he>כולבה</he></cite> a. <cite ref="K00263"><he>כולבא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 1:1:10">Y. Ned. I, 36ᵈ</cite> top <he>כולכה</he>, v. <cite ref="S01621"><he>קַנְתָּא</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>כּוּלְבַיָּיא</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 13:21">Targ. I Sam. XIII, 21</cite>.
